entities.summary: Aaron James Henry is an American professional basketball player for Nagoya Diamond Dolphins of the Japanese B.League. He previously played for the Philadelphia 76ers of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and the Delaware Blue Coats of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Michigan State Spartans.
